title: WorkflowMiningReport
description: Report produced by the workflow preference miner from a set of transcripts.

window.description: Time window used for filtering transcripts (e.g. '7d', '30d', or an ISO range).

atoms.description: Extracted preference atoms. Raw transcript content is never stored here.

proposed_selfsteer_ref.description: Path to the SelfSteer proposal artifact if one was emitted.

redacted_count.description: Number of atoms that were discarded by the secret scan.
